City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
OCTOBER 1, 2026 -
06:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. All Oral Communications speaker requests must be received by the Clerk by the start of oral
communications. Up to 30 minutes are available for comments on items not on the agenda. Remarks must be addressed to the Planning Commission as a whole. State law prohibits Planning Commission action on non?agenda items. As appropriate, comments may be referred to the City Manager for follow?up or placement on a future agenda. Please be aware that the Mayor has the authority to reduce equally each speaker’s time to accommodate a larger number of speakers.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a speaker request to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Please be aware that the Chair has the authority to reduce equally each speaker’s time to accommodate a larger number of speakers. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Planning Commissioner or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
6A.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES of the September 17, 2026, Planning Commission meeting.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Staff recommends approval.
Approval of the September 17, 2026 Minutes
6B.
PROJECT NAME: Torrey Crest Final Map; CASE NUMBER: SUB-008060-2025 FILING DATE: April 25, 2025; APPLICANT: Richmond American Homes of Maryland, Inc., A Maryland Corporation; LOCATION: 1220 Melba Rd (259-180-16, 259-180-33, 259-180-09, 259-180-10, 259-181-02, 259-181-03, 259-181-04, 256-392-06, 256-392-11, 256-392-12); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider approval of the recordation of the Final Map; ZONING/OVERLAY: Residential 3 (R-3) Zone and the Coastal Overlay Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15268(b)(3), which considers approval of final subdivision maps as ministerial projects.
STAFF CONTACT: Jaylee McDowell, Principal Engineer, (760) 943-2109 or jmcdowell@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
Torrey Crest Final Map - Report
Additional Correspondence
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS To speak on action items, please submit a speaker request to the Commission Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Please be aware that the Chair has the authority to reduce equally each speaker’s time to accommodate a larger number of speakers.
8A.
PROJECT NAME: Kay Twin Homes; CASE NUMBERS: MULTI-007713-2024, DR-007739-2024, CDP-007737-2024; FILING DATE: November 21, 2024; APPLICANT: Kay Family Trust; LOCATION: 2119 Cambridge Avenue (APN: 260-411-56 and -57); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a design review permit and coastal development permit to demolish an existing single-family residence and construct a new two-story twin home structure over a basement with a junior accessory dwelling unit (JADU) within each twin home unit. The south lot proposes an attached garage and the north lot proposes a detached garage, both accessed from the alley; ZONING/OVERLAY: Residential 11 (R-11) Zone, Coastal Overlay Zone, and Special Study Overlay Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines section 15301(l) which exempts the demolition of one single-family residence and 15303(a) which exempts the construction of small structures, including a single-family residence and second dwelling unit. Up to three single family residences may be constructed under this exemption; therefore, the proposed twin home may utilize this exemption. None of the exceptions prescribed under Section 15300.2 of the CEQA Guidelines apply and no historic resources are affected by the proposed project.
STAFF CONTACT: Kaipo Eager-Kaninau, Associate Planner: (760) 633-2717 or kkaninau@encinitasca.gov.
Staff recommends approval
